notes: Literature check (strict, cutoff 2025-09-24) could not run: the arXiv API returned HTTP 429 and then timed out, so the skill's fallback was used (knowledge-only references marked [verify], no novelty verdicts from search). integrity_scan.py was not run because this evaluation restricted tools; a manual grep found no reviewer-directed text. Ambiguities: (1) the skill requires running integrity_scan and related_search, while the evaluation rules allow only the aggregation script plus related_search; (2) the EIC-weighted rating rounds to 3 while the composite band is 2 (flagged), and departing from the starting point requires a 'named verified issue the ratings did not account for', which is judgment-dependent when reviewers overlap; (3) DA criterion 3 decision table row 2 vs 3 turns on a sweep the paper does not show, so upholding DA-C1 relies on 'grid search on the test set' being a selection by score; (4) a pool-position/composite consistency warning for R1 had to be resolved by changing the pool position (25 to 30) rather than the scores; (5) Table 3 extraction was garbled, limiting E1/E6 checks; (6) the skill asks five 'independent' reviewers from one context, which cannot be truly independent.
